description:
HushThreads v0.0.12 has 17 patches for Threads 450.0.0.51.78 (com.instagram.barcelona), and builds 449.0.0.54.82 and 448.0.0.54.85 work too. It's built on Morphe patcher 1.15.1. Six patches are new. Save photos and videos puts a Save row in a post's menu, and Max image quality, Disable screenshot detection, Change version code, Remove share targets and Trust user-added certificates are switches you tick when you patch. HushThreads also has its own row in Threads' settings now. Selected by default are Disable analytics, Hide ads, Hide suggested users, HushThreads settings, Open links in browser, Remove the advertising ID, Restore screens on re-signed builds, Sanitize sharing links and Save photos and videos. Also available are Block background-return feed refresh, Change version code, Disable screenshot detection, Disable video autoplay, Max image quality, Pure black dark mode, Remove share targets and Trust user-added certificates.

Sign in with your Instagram username and password.

Validation: 804 runtime tests passed locally. All 212 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 17 patches applied to Threads 450.0.0.51.78, 449.0.0.54.82 and 448.0.0.54.85 without forcing, and the release receipt records all three runs.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Threads 450.0.0.51.78 (version code 512008342), or of 449.0.0.54.82 or 448.0.0.54.85. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Threads APK. Uninstall the stock Threads first, and keep the manager's signing key for updates.
